title: Viva Insights: export de-identified agent metrics from the Agent Dashboard
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned export, its default availability, eligible users and tenant controls. It distinguishes the tenant notice from Learn's Agent 365 documentation; minor corrections should preserve the data-availability qualifications and note Microsoft's differing navigation instructions for identification policies.
